set.pl: Family strip E1/2 sec 19 and farm SW sec 20, Alamo Twp (1890 atlas); he died in a tenant house near Williams Station.
pinev: Parcel-level: the 1890 Kalamazoo County atlas, Alamo plate, shows the family's 20-acre strip in the E half of sec. 19 T1S R12W and a 79-acre farm with a house mark in the SW of sec. 20; his estate sold Alamo land in Dec 1908. Pin between the two; radius covers both (about 700 m).

set.tovw: No hoard claimed (caches-only rule): record only
set.n: Outlaw dugout with a hidden back room, ravine in Lake Prairie Twp (1890)
set.pl: A ravine in Lake Prairie Township, Nicollet County (GNIS township point); ravine not located
pinev: Township-level: the 1890 reports put the dugout in a ravine in Lake Prairie Twp; pin at GNIS Township of Lake Prairie (about 5 km).
set.st: Dec 1890: hunters in a ravine in Lake Prairie Township found an old door into a dugout; a blind door of hewed logs led to a 20x16 ft room with bunks for about 30, a stove and a skull; it was claimed as a James-Younger hideout. No loot was claimed. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
